description: Synthetic (typed) Environmental Science test. Exercises: answers written out of order (Q4's answer is written first), one genuinely unlabeled answer, one answer mislabeled with a number that doesn't exist on the paper (7 — the paper only has 1-5), and one answer that is entirely off-topic and must stay unmatched rather than be force-mapped.

1..note: correctly labelled, though written second on the page

2..note: the student wrote no label at all for this one — must still be matched by content/position, not left unanswered

4..note: correctly labelled, though written FIRST on the page — out-of-order must not break label matching

5..note: mislabelled '7' on the sheet — no question 7 exists, so label matching must fail over to the semantic step, which should still recognise this as the water-cycle answer for Q5

unmatchedSegments.note: genuinely off-topic (oxygen's chemical symbol) — must remain unmatched, not force-assigned to any question
